posts.title: Witch’s Hut: Potion Crafting and Alchemy
posts.summary: Master the art of brewing powerful potions.
posts.body:
Visit the **Witch's Hut** for these recipes:

- **Health Potion**: Red herb + water.
- **Mana Elixir**: Blue crystal + distilled essence.
- **Stamina Draught**: Root blend + minor enchantment.

Brewing is an art—experiment to find new effects.

posts.title: Blacksmith’s Corner: Weapon Upgrade Tips
posts.summary: How to get the most out of upgrades.
posts.body:
Use these tips at the **Blacksmith**:

- **Salvage Materials**: Recycle unwanted gear for components.
- **Upgrade Order**: Reinforce blade before hilt for best durability.
- **Enhancement Runes**: Apply to add elemental damage.

Upgrade smarter, fight stronger!

posts.title: Player’s Keep Tour: Housing Your Heroes
posts.summary: A walkthrough of customizing your Player’s Keep.
posts.body:
Your **Player's Keep** is more than storage:

1. **Furniture**: Place trophies and banners.
2. **Workshops**: Build a **Blacksmith** or **Alchemy Lab**.
3. **Defense**: Add traps and guards to protect your assets.

Show off your achievements in style.

posts.title: Event Recap: Catacombs Raid Success
posts.summary: Highlights from our latest community raid.
posts.body:
Last weekend's **Catacombs Raid** was a triumph:

- **Participants**: Over 200 players joined.
- **Boss Defeated**: The Undead King fell in under 15 minutes.
- **Rewards**: Exclusive titles and loot drops for top contributors.

Thanks to everyone who took part!

posts.title: World Mode Preview: The Heroes Guild
posts.summary: Get ready for the upcoming World Mode features.
posts.body:
World Mode introduces:

- **Open World**: Explore beyond the main campaign.
- **Player Housing**: Customize your **Player's Keep**.
- **Community Projects**: Collaborate on world events and builds.

Stay tuned for launch details!

posts.title: Tokenomics: Understanding $GGLD and $GGEM
posts.summary: A deep dive into in-game currencies.
posts.body:
Guild Saga uses two main tokens:

- **$GGLD**: Earned through gameplay; used for basics like repairs.
- **$GGEM**: Premium currency; used for cosmetic items and special quests.
- **Exchange Rates**: 1 $GGEM = 100 $GGLD on the open market.

Manage your wallet to maximize your adventure.

posts.title: Loot Drop Tables Demystified
posts.body:
Loot falls into three categories:

1. **Common**: High drop rate, basic gear.
2. **Uncommon**: Moderate drop rate, improved stats.
3. **Rare/Epic**: Low drop rate, powerful effects.

Check *Loot Drop Tables* in the docs to plan your hunts.

posts.title: Mercenary Guide: Class and Level Overview
posts.summary: Learn how to hire and level mercenaries.
posts.body:
Mercenaries offer flexible support:

- **Classes**: Swordsman, Archer, Mage, Healer.
- **Level Cap**: Your account level determines max mercenary rank.
- **Hiring Costs**: Pay 50 $GGLD per rank increase.

Recruit mercenaries to adapt to any challenge.

posts.title: NFT Heroes: Art and Attributes Explained
posts.summary: Breakdown of hero rarity and stat bonuses.
posts.body:
Your NFT heroes come with unique perks:

- **Rarity Tiers**: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary.
- **Attributes**: Each hero has strength, agility, intelligence.
- **Art Styles**: Hand-drawn pixel sprites with exclusive skins for top-tier.

Discover your next champion today.
